source_text.body:
Build a Pokemon-style dog collecting app
A user had Replit Agent build a catch-em-all dog app whose rarity comes from scraped American Kennel Club regional population data.
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
User instructed Replit Agent to build the full app. The agent scraped American Kennel Club regional population data to set dog rarity values for catches. Source states the agent handled the entire build.
How it went
App was completed as a dog-themed catch-em-all experience. No further results or shortfalls reported.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Build a catch-em-all style app for [topic, e.g. dog breeds] where rarity is based on real data from [source website, e.g. regional population or registration stats]. Scrape or import the data, let users collect items and view their collection, and deploy it. Finish when the app is live and rarity tiers are visibly tied to the data.
Original source: https://x.com/DanielPrevoznik/status/2088991596771459241
